design.name: 啸獭
design.brief: A Himalayan marmot (旱獭) sentinel charged with corrupted thunder: a fat round-bodied plateau marmot with a short bushy tail, small round ears, big buck teeth and stubby clawed paws, shown STANDING UPRIGHT on its hind legs like a lookout, chubby belly, mouth wide open in a sharp alarm whistle. Golden-brown fur with a cream belly and a dark face mask, carved in a few large clumps; the fur bristles up with static, tufts on the back and cheeks tipped with magenta-violet sparks; the puffed-up tail tip is a glowing magenta static ball (weak spot). Small glowing violet eyes. Cute but feral. NOT a squirrel, NOT a beaver: a stout marmot.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: standing upright on its hind legs like a marmot sentinel, the body vertical, both hind feet flat on the ground and apart, the forepaws held a little in front of the chest and away from the body with the claws open and separated, the head facing straight ahead with the mouth closed (the two big front teeth showing), the bushy tail resting straight down behind it with its tip on the ground; the bristling fur tufts and lightning veins painted as opaque shapes (no halo); MODELLING BASE STATE WITH EFFECTS SEPARATED: nothing glows and nothing emits light anywhere: no bloom, no halo, no light spill on the surrounding fur, no sparks, no electric arcs, and no crystal-like or spark-shaped spikes sticking out of the body (all of those are added later as game effects); every lightning vein is only a thin FLAT painted magenta line on the surface, like a tattoo, with crisp edges and the same matte lighting as the rest of the body; the eyes are flat painted colour; its fur tufts and its bushy tail are plain brown and cream fur like the rest of the body (NOT magenta, NOT crystal spikes: the tail only lights up in the game)
design.turnaround_digits: each forepaw with four separate claws and each hind foot with five separate toes, countable; the ears, the fur spikes and the whole tail fully inside the frame.
